verdict.rationale: Cerebras keeps a browsable catalog of open-source models, and a community user reports that it is 'genuinely difficult to keep up with the models' while citing the recently hosted Qwen 3.8 27B. That points to frequent catalog additions, but nothing documents how soon models arrive after their public release. missing for 10: any documented day-0 or time-to-availability commitment, dated release-to-availability examples for specific models, independent corroboration of launch-day availability.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can get newly released open-weight models on the platform quickly after their public release

citations.quote: Browse all models available on Cerebras public endpoints.
Find the right open-source model for your workload on Cerebras
It is genuinely difficult to keep up with the models. The output is so fast. Qwen 3.8 27B is likely one of the strongest models they've hosted so far.
